customer_message.subject: Rent increase after renovation and interest rate
customer_message.body:
Name: Hannah Gallagher
Address: Schulhausstrasse 79, 3612 Steffisburg, 4 rooms
Landlord: Wohnwerk Thur GmbH

Message:
Wohnwerk Thur renovated our building this year: new heating system, new windows and insulated façade. At the tenants' meeting in August the manager told us that our rents will go up because of this renovation work, and that the higher reference rate will be passed on at the same time. He talked about "around 12 %" in total.

They said we would get the "official paperwork" in due course. I'm still waiting for it.

My net rent is CHF 2390. 12 % seems excessive to me. How can I check whether such an increase is justified, and what should I do in the meantime?

Hannah Gallagher
